changeSet.comment: Soft-delete duplicate seed tax configs — now managed from frontend UI
changeSet.sql: UPDATE tax_configs SET is_deleted = true, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE is_deleted = false AND tax_config_id IN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MIN(tc2.tax_config_id) FROM tax_configs tc2 WHERE tc2.is_deleted = false GROUP BY tc2.country_code, tc2.tax_type, tc2.effective_from ) AS tmp )

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO agreement_tax_configs (agreement_id, tax_config_id, apply_order, accumulate_from_orders) SELECT a.agreement_id, a.tax_config_id, 1, NULL FROM agreements a WHERE a.tax_config_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agreement_tax_configs atc WHERE atc.agreement_id = a.agreement_id )
